decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & Access Statement, Environmental Noise Survey (Ref 11/3690/R1), Memorandum (Ref 11/3690/M1), P-10994-100, P-10994-101-A, P-10994-201, P-10994-202, P-10994-212, P-10994-213-A Received 08/12/2011 and P-10994-112-C Received 23/01/20012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The rating level of noise emitted from fixed plant on the site, shall be lower than the existing background noise level by 10dB. The noise levels shall be determined at the nearest noise sensitive locations. The measurements shall be made according to BS4141:1997

Condition : 4 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing No. P-10994-112-C and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 5 - No servicing of the premises shall be undertaken outside the hours of 07:00-19:00 Monday to Friday, 07:00-17:00 Saturdays and 10:00-14:00 Sundays, Public and Bank Holidays.
description: Installation of entrance doors to Staines Road and northern elevations, ATM (including bollards) to northern elevation, new service entrance to western elevation, chiller unit and enclosure, and alterations to various openings to the premises
